xBRIEFInfo.description: Bug cohort story for GitHub issue #3234 (operator-approved swarm 2026-08-10).

plan.title: fix(pr): merge-ready fails closed on absent required ruleset check contexts

narratives.Description: pr:merge-ready can report merge_ready true when repository rulesets require status-check contexts that have no check runs on the PR HEAD (path-filtered workflows never schedule). evaluateCiGate only inventories observed check runs, so absent required contexts are invisible while GitHub blocks merge.
narratives.UserStory: As a merge-ready gate consumer, I want absent ruleset-required check contexts treated as blockers, so that merge-ready never greens when GitHub would still block the merge.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: In packages/core/src/pr-merge-readiness, resolve applicable required status-check contexts from branch protection and/or rulesets (REST), compare against exact-HEAD check runs, and fail closed when a required context has no matching check run. Preserve existing handling for success, skipped, pending, failed, and capacity-stalled observed checks. Add unit tests with fixture required contexts and empty/partial check-run lists. Cite #3234 in CHANGELOG. Do not skip CI or lower conf floors.
narratives.Overview: fix(pr): merge-ready fails closed on absent required ruleset check contexts
narratives.NonGoals: Epic #3237 children; docs-only mitigation; changing consumer repo rulesets.
narratives.AcceptanceJustification: Three acceptance items cover fix, fail-closed gate, and regression tests for this single-issue bug.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a PR with ruleset-required contexts, when merge-ready evaluates, the required context list includes those names even if no check run exists.
Given a required context with no check run on HEAD, when pr:merge-ready runs, merge_ready is false and the absent context is named in output/JSON.
Given unit fixtures covering observed-green + absent-required, when vitest runs pr-merge-readiness, cases pass; CHANGELOG cites #3234.
